item.tib: byang chub sgrub thabs lam rim gyi 'grel pa gzhan phan snying po
item.coloph: snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa/ rje btsun yar me ba chen po shes rab 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i/ byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi bon lam gyi rim pas (pa) tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya nyi shu pa'i rnams (rnam) bshad/ gzhan phan snying po zhes bya ba 'di/ don gnyer can slob ma sde snod 'dzin pa/ d+ho tsha drang srong rgyal mtshan dang*/ dad pa dang gtong ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sku mched gnyis kyis nan cher bskyal nas/ dpal ldan bzang po ri pa'i (yi) btsun pa/ rgyal mtshan mchog legs kyis/ khrom dpyid (skyid) tog gis (gi) sa cha bzang grub gling gi dgon par sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems la phan pa rgya chen por brgya (rgya) chen po gyur cig/
